notes: CR 603.4, the second check: Turret Ogre enters while a 4/4 is on the battlefield, so its intervening-'if' ability triggers. The 4/4 leaves before the ability resolves (hold_triggers, then a move to the graveyard), so the condition is false on resolution and the ability does nothing: the opponent stays at 20. Companion of intervening_if_false_when_the_event_happens.json; this half held before the 2026-11-05 fix too.
